column3: Close to the Hebrew; “answered … and said” is rendered “said.”
Close to the Hebrew; the four nouns are regrouped as “eminence and dignity” and “honor and majesty.”
Close to the Hebrew; “the furies of your anger” is rendered “the overflowings of your anger.”
Close to the Hebrew; “in their place” is rendered “where they stand.”
“I will praise you” is rendered “I will also confess to you.”
Close to the Hebrew; “with you” is rendered “as well as you.”
“It stiffens its tail” is rendered “He bends his tail.”
Close to the Hebrew; “they carry produce to him” is rendered “bring him food.”
Close to the Hebrew; “poplars” is rendered “willows.”
“Behold, the river is violent” is rendered “If a river rages,” and “for” as “Though.”
“By his eyes” is rendered “when he is on watch,” and “with snares” as “With barbs”; the meaning is uncertain.
